Mummichog (m/z-direct, human_mfn empirical network) returned Arachidonic acid metabolism as the top hit (rank 1, p = 0.0015, overlap = 13), with Glycerophospholipid metabolism (rank 2, p = 0.0094) and Leukotriene metabolism (rank 4, p = 0.038) also significant. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed enrichment signal on related glycan and fructose/mannose pathways. Metabolites driving the arachidonic acid hit include the canonical substrate arachidonic acid itself (C00219), the two lipoxygenase products 5-HETE (C04805) and 15-HETE (C04742), the cyclopentenone prostaglandin 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2 (C14717), and the leukotriene branchpoint Leukotriene A4 (C00909). Glycerol (C00116) participates in both arachidonic acid and glycerophospholipid networks. The biological picture is one of activated phospholipase A2 releasing arachidonic acid from membrane glycerophospholipids, followed by three competing oxidative fates: COX-1/COX-2 (PTGS1/PTGS2) producing cyclopentenone prostaglandins, 5-lipoxygenase (ALOX5) producing 5-HETE and the leukotriene A4 branchpoint, and 15-lipoxygenase (ALOX15) producing 15-HETE. final_narrative_text: Multi-paradigm pathway analysis of nine differentially abundant metabolites identifies arachidonic acid metabolism as the dominant affected pathway with strong cross-tool agreement. Mummichog (m/z-direct, human_mfn empirical network) returned Arachidonic acid metabolism as the top hit (rank 1, p = 0.0015, overlap = 13), with Glycerophospholipid metabolism (rank 2, p = 0.0094) and Leukotriene metabolism (rank 4, p = 0.038) also significant. MetaboAnalystR KEGG PSEA confirmed enrichment signal on related glycan and fructose/mannose pathways. Metabolites driving the arachidonic acid hit include the canonical substrate arachidonic acid itself (C00219), the two lipoxygenase products 5-HETE (C04805) and 15-HETE (C04742), the cyclopentenone prostaglandin 15-deoxy-Δ12,14-PGJ2 (C14717), and the leukotriene branchpoint Leukotriene A4 (C00909). Glycerol (C00116) participates in both arachidonic acid and glycerophospholipid networks. The biological picture is one of activated phospholipase A2 releasing arachidonic acid from membrane glycerophospholipids, followed by three competing oxidative fates: COX-1/COX-2 (PTGS1/PTGS2) producing cyclopentenone prostaglandins, 5-lipoxygenase (ALOX5) producing 5-HETE and the leukotriene A4 branchpoint, and 15-lipoxygenase (ALOX15) producing 15-HETE. N-Acetylgalactosamine (C01074) and 4-hydroxybenzoate (C00156) map to separate but parallel glycosphingolipid and phenol/tyrosine metabolism modules consistent with broader oxidative-stress phenotypes.
